notes.title: Courier Tale - Prologue Demo V0.5.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The Courier Tale Prologue Demo has been updated with the latest changes. Here's the patch notes...

### Courier Tale - Prologue Demo V0.5.1 ###
Updated: 29-01-24
* Updated music.
* Updated sound fx.
* Various graphics, audio, gameplay, dialogue and UI updates and tweaks

notes.title: Courier Tale - Prologue Demo V0.4.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The Courier Tale Prologue Demo has been updated to the new version being shown at conventions in 2023. While the demo is the same demo, during the polishing phase of recent months, there has been various tweaks and updates from the 2022 version of the demo...

### Courier Tale - Prologue Demo V0.4.2 ###
Updated: 25-07-23
* New title screen.
* New in-game menu.
* New collector card sub-menu.
* Mouse support removed (controller and keyboard support continues)
* Fixed visual glitch when selecting a dialogue option
* Various graphics, audio, gameplay, dialogue and UI updates and tweaks

notes.title: Courier Tale - Prologue Demo V0.3.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The Courier Tale Prologue Demo has been updated to the version that was showcased recently at Perth Games Festival 2022. There's been a few tweaks and improvements since the last version...

### Courier Tale - Prologue Demo V0.3.2 ###
Update 22-11-22

* Added bus sequence and other tweaks to the start of the demo.
* Various graphic updates and tweaks.

notes.title: Courier Tale - Prologue Demo V0.2.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The Courier Tale Prologue Demo has been updated to the current version being showcased at 2022 conventions. There's been a few tweaks and improvements since the Steam Next Fest June 2022 demo...

### Courier Tale - Prologue Demo V0.2.2 ###
Update 05-09-22

* New version number format.
* Mouse support improved (still not optimal, keyboard or controller recommended).
* Interior doors now auto-exit on player touch without player input.
* Various graphical, dialogue and game tweaks.

notes.title: Courier Tale - Prologue Demo V011 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
### Courier Tale - Prologue Demo V011 ###
Update 11-06-22

* Updated demo splash screen.
* Can now exit interiors with player touch.
* Added a transition sequence in one scene.
* Various game and UI tweaks.
